input: Create a digital inventory of home valuables for insurance

gold.taskTitle: Build a Digital Home Valuables Inventory for Insurance
gold.taskDescription: Create a comprehensive digital record of home valuables to support insurance coverage and claims.

questions.title: Which rooms or categories of valuables are included?
questions.description: Understand the scope — electronics, jewelry, art, furniture, appliances, collectibles, or the entire home.

questions.title: What tool or format should the inventory be stored in?
questions.description: Determine the preferred format — spreadsheet, dedicated app, cloud document, or insurance-provided portal.

questions.title: Do you have existing receipts or appraisals to reference?
questions.description: Find out whether supporting documentation already exists or needs to be gathered from scratch.

questions.title: Will you photograph or video each item as evidence?
questions.description: Clarify whether visual documentation is part of the plan and how it will be stored or organized.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this inventory?
questions.description: Establish a target date — driven by a policy renewal, a recent purchase, or a move.

questions.title: Which specific insurance provider will this inventory support?
questions.description: Identify the insurer to check whether they have required fields, templates, or submission guidelines.

questions.title: Are you doing this alone or with another household member?
questions.description: Determine whether the task is a solo effort or shared, which affects how to divide and coordinate the work.
